messages:
Tara Nguyen: Morning — quick async standup from runtime side. What I did: merged prefetch backpressure patch (PR #1456) to reduce tail-slot thrash. Noticed a tiny p95 regression on microbench for short prompts. Blockers: need benches + canary runs to confirm, unsure if kv eviction thresholds interacted. Today: run microbench on canary, consider revert if regression persists. @Mike can you run canary microbench?

Mike Patel: on it, kicking off microbench on runtime-canary-3. Will run seq=16 & batch=1 first. ping if you want rollback. :eyes:

Sasha Ivanova: repro'd quickly on my laptop — batch<=2 + seq=16 shows ~5-7ms extra p95. Grep from kernel logs: `2026-03-17T22:03:14.321Z kernel: slot_wait_ms=3.8 prefetch=1 evict_attempt=0` — looks like extra queueing in the batcher. Will paste a tiny log snippet after run.

Eli Gomez: FYI yesterday kv-warmup threshold got bumped to 0.6 in canary config (reason: reduce OOMs). That could change slot occupancy and make backpressure kick earlier. Might be a combined effect.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy finished: runtime-canary-3 -> build 2026.03.17-rc3, status: success. :white_check_mark:

Tara Nguyen: thanks. microbench command for reference: `./bench.sh --env canary --seq 16 --batch 1 --runs 1000 --track p50,p95` — please paste raw p95 numbers here when done.

Mike Patel: running now, ETA ~10m. I'll leave logs in /tmp/bench-run-176982 and link when done.

Sasha Ivanova: snip from local run: ```kernel queue: +1.9ms median, +6.2ms p95 when prefetch backpressure enabled. trace id=abc123``` — looks correlated with slot prefetch wakeups.

Mike Patel: bench complete: baseline (main) p95=22.1ms, canary p95=28.5ms, throughput same, CPU usage +4%. Raw: p50 (main)=8.3ms p50 (canary)=10.1ms. putting logs at s3://redwood-bench/176982/mike-raw.log

Tara Nguyen: that's larger than we want. Reverting PR #1456 to isolate. I'll open the revert and trigger a fresh canary.

Sasha Ivanova: I'll prep a follow-up that gates backpressure with slot occupancy heuristics (only enable when occupancy>0.7) and add a microbench test for batch<=2.

Eli Gomez: cool. I'll also backfill telemetry to capture slot_wait_ms by seq len so we can monitor in prod.

Mike Patel: noted, re-run after revert and report.

Tara Nguyen: thanks all — moving to rollback, will update when canary finishes. :house:
